result.rationale: The diff adds an unconditional Salesforce token refresh (fetch to login.salesforce.com/services/oauth2/token) directly in the service constructor path, which runs on every service instantiation rather than only when a refresh is needed — a concrete, quota-burning behavior change introduced by this diff. The `if (response.statusText !== "OK")` check is also genuinely fragile (e.g., non-2xx error responses carry their own statusText and could pass this check's logic poorly; status 200 responses are the norm, not a guaranteed exact phrase). Both observations cite specific added code in the diff.
